fusions.name: Heartrot Cleave
fusions.desc: A cleaving chop that uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 18 slashing damage, 60% more for each one used, and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Felling Sweep
fusions.desc: A sweeping chop through a cone 2.5 tiles deep that deals 12 slashing damage, stuns enemies for 1 second and has a 40% chance per hit to leave them [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Deadwood Reek
fusions.desc: The nearest body within 9.5 tiles rots where it lies for 8 seconds, and gives every enemy within 4 tiles of it Rot for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Windfall
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, spores strike the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 8 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
